name: show_timer_display

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_ShowTimerDisplay reads the two top Script values as a display-preset selector and reference time, then decrements stackTop by two

notes: The handler maps display presets 0 through 11 to fixed timer-layout configurations and passes the selected configuration plus reference_time_frames to func_00111E20. That routine stores the reference time in D_004D29B0, formats it and the live timer D_002B916C into hours, minutes, seconds, and hundredths through func_00111C98, initializes the display, and registers func_00111D98 to refresh it. It does not start or change the live timer. Command 661 calls func_00111F00 to terminate the display. The JP corpus contains ten calls across tz04.ard and tz05.ard; every call uses preset 1 and a reference time loaded from local 6, whose fallback value is 18000 frames.
